body: Coordinator habit (Fable2, after several slips on 2026-11-03). Never send a message that cites a tracker item id in the SAME parallel batch as the engram add that creates the item. File first, read the returned short_ref, then send. Placeholder or truncated ids such as "w-04-pending", "w-c9…" or "w-0…" force follow-up corrections.
